items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: This boy, Ernest Rebannan, he was a reader. He was the one who taught me how to play bass drum.

ctx.x: The dipotry number was a read. Well, son, he didn't read, but he had it, yeah. That son had really got it, yeah. Now when I was a man, I joined the Tartucula band. This boy, Ernest Rebannan, he was a reader. He was the one who taught me how to play bass drum. Because I worked with him so on. And he used to tell me, why don't you learn bass drum. He said, you know after, honey, you know it. But I walked with you so long. I said, oh man, I don't want to play that thing. Toad that thing. Oh, he said, you ain't got…
Oh, I said, I can play but I don't look.
